'''Nemom''' is a suburb of [[Thiruvananthapuram]], the capital city of [[Kerala]], [[India]].

It is surrounded by [[Thirumala, Thiruvananthapuram|Thirumala]] in the north, [[Malayinkeezhu]] in the north-east, [[Balaramapuram]] in the south-east, [[Kovalam]] in the south and Thiruvallam in the west. Nemom falls within the municipal corporation of Thiruvananthapuram, though partly exclusive. It is connected with [[Thiruvananthapuram]], [[Neyyattinkara]], [[Vizhinjam]], [[Poovar]], [[Kattakkada]], [[Nagarcoil]], and [[Kanyakumari (town)|Kanyakumari]] through the main arterial highway [[National Highway 66 (India)|National Highway 66]].

Nemom has a Government [[Ayurveda]] Clinic.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.yentha.com/business/view/ayushya-ayurvedic-clinic-nemom-trivandrum |title=Ayushya Ayurvedic Clinic in Nemom, Trivandrum |publisher=Yentha.com |date=2010-07-25 |access-date=2013-10-26}}</ref> There is a public market at Pravachambalam, about one kilometre away from Nemom.{{Citation needed|date=October 2012}} [[Vellayani Devi Temple]]<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.templepurohit.com/hindu-temple/vellayani-devi-temple/|title=Vellayani Devi Temple - Info, Timings, Photos, History, Videos|website=TemplePurohit - Your Spiritual Destination {{!}} Bhakti, Shraddha Aur Ashirwad|language=en-US|access-date=2019-07-01}}</ref> is located in Nemom.

==Administration==
===Parliamentary and Assembly constituencies===
Nemom is part of [[Nemom Assembly constituency|Nemom]] Assembly constituency and [[Thiruvananthapuram Lok Sabha constituency|Thiruvananthapuram]] Parliamentary constituency. After the [[2024 Indian general election]], [[Shashi Tharoor]], MP <ref>{{cite web |url=http://india.gov.in/govt/loksabhampdetail.php?mpcode=4569 |title=Dr. Shashi Tharoor - Members of Parliament (Lok Sabha) - Who's Who - Government: National Portal of India |publisher=India.gov.in |access-date=2012-08-19 |archive-date=26 December 2020 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20201226083620/https://www.india.gov.in/ |url-status=live }}</ref> of [[Indian National Congress]] represents Thiruvananthapuram in [[Lok Sabha]]. [[Rajeev Chandrasekhar]], MLA of [[Bharatiya Janata Party]] is representing Nemom Assembly constituency in the [[Kerala Legislative Assembly]] after [[2026 Kerala Legislative Assembly election|2026 assembly election]]. He is also the state president of [[BJP Kerala]].<ref>{{Cite web |last=Service |first=Express News |date=2025-03-25 |title=Rajeev Chandrasekhar takes over as president of BJP's Kerala unit |url=https://www.newindianexpress.com/states/kerala/2025/Mar/25/rajeev-chandrasekhar-takes-over-as-president-of-bjps-kerala-unit |access-date=2025-03-25 |website=The New Indian Express |language=en}}</ref> A prominent voice in India's digital and economic policy, he is a former Union Minister, having served as the Minister of State for the Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY), the Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship, and the Ministry of Jal Shakti.

===City corporation===
Nemom consists of 2 wards of [[Thiruvananthapuram Corporation]]. The 54th ward is named Nemom, and the 55th is named Ponnumangalam. After the [[2025 Kerala local elections]], Sridevi S K of [[Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP)]] is the present councilor of the Ponnumangalam Corporation Division. Senior [[BJP]] leader M.R. Gopan  is the councilor of Nemom Corporation Division<ref>{{cite web|url=https://trend.kerala.nic.in/|title=2025 Kerala local election results|work=SEC Kerala|accessdate=14 December 2025}}</ref>. M.R. Gopan is the previous Leader of the Opposition in the Thiruvananthapuram Municipal Corporation during 2020-25 period<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.thehindu.com/news/national/kerala/dramatic-scenes-at-council-meeting/article65318263.ece|title=Dramatic scenes at council meeting|author=Staff Reporter|date=13 April 2022|accessdate=19 January 2025|via=www.thehindu.com}}</ref>.

===Taluk===
Nemom village comes under [[Thiruvananthapuram taluk]] of the four taluks of [[Thiruvananthapuram district]] namely [[Chirayinkeezhu taluk|Chirayinkeezhu]], [[Neyyattinkara taluk|Neyyattinkara]], [[Nedumangad taluk|Nedumangad]] and Thiruvananthapuram.
